rounds.response:
Customer support automation maps to customer experience and cost-to-serve (retain revenue, reduce support spend); demand forecasting maps to revenue optimization and margin improvement (inventory efficiency, better promotions); internal knowledge search maps to productivity and risk reduction (faster onboarding, preserve institutional knowledge).  
Benefits: faster responses and lower support costs; improved forecast accuracy, fewer stockouts/overstock and better margins; and significant time savings plus better decisions from easier access to expertise.  
Risks: data quality and governance gaps, model errors/hallucinations (especially for knowledge search), integration complexity with legacy systems, privacy/compliance exposure, and adoption/change management.  
Guardrails and KPIs: require dataset readiness and access controls, human-in-loop validation, and measure CSAT, AHT, forecast MAPE, inventory turns, and time-to-answer for each pilot.  
Recommend running all three as 8–12 week pilots in parallel, convene a shared steering committee for risk/vendor decisions, and hold a formal go/no‑go at week 10.
